verdict: A credible roofer whose booking page is empty and whose mobile hero never asks for the job.

leaks.title: Book Estimate lands on an empty page
leaks.body: Every Book Estimate link says 'Nothing to book right now.' The only working form is a small contact form that is not in the main menu.

leaks.title: The mobile hero sells a video, not an inspection
leaks.body: No service, city, offer, or call button appears above the fold. The page is locked to 320px with 13px body text.

leaks.title: The phone is not a link on desktop
leaks.body: Mobile has two click-to-call links, but desktop shows a plain number and there is no text path.

strengths: 35+ years in business, license, bond, workers-comp policy, CSLB badge, and A+ BBB.
Real job photos and two detailed, named testimonials.
Short three-field form, chat widget, LocalBusiness schema, and a 3.0s median mobile LCP.

fixes.fix: Turn booking back on and add a callback promise
Rebuild the mobile hero with offer, Call, and Book
Publish price ranges, tiers, maintenance plan, and financing
Add review aggregate, case studies, captions, and warranty terms
Compress images and remove unused apps

fixNote: The first three are worth about 27 points under V1. This legacy scorecard keeps the original 42-check rubric and is not directly comparable to a V2 score.

spanish.note: No Spanish page, switcher, or notice. In a bilingual market, that leaves a real segment with no path to call.

nextSteps: This week: fix Book Estimate and add Book to the mobile bottom bar.
Next two weeks: publish the price architecture and the proof block.
Before ad spend: rebuild the mobile hero and get LCP under 2.5 seconds.
footer: Synthetic legacy V1 example. Not a real business.
